placeholder_policy.label: AI / LLM API keys
placeholder_policy.examples: sk-…, sk-proj-…, gsk_…, hf_…, Anthropic keys
placeholder_policy.why: Cloud model credentials — highest egress risk (OWASP LLM07)

placeholder_policy.label: Cloud & DevOps secrets
placeholder_policy.examples: AKIA…, GitHub/GitLab PATs, Slack xox-/webhooks, JWTs, Vault hvs., connection URIs
placeholder_policy.why: Infrastructure takeover if leaked to an outside model

placeholder_policy.label: Session / identity tokens
placeholder_policy.examples: Bearer JWTs, PHPSESSID, JSESSIONID, refresh/access tokens
placeholder_policy.why: Account takeover — must not leave cleartext (CISA AI data security)

placeholder_policy.label: People & HR identifiers
placeholder_policy.examples: Usernames, user names, employee IDs, names+IDs, SSN, salary figures
placeholder_policy.why: Identity / regulated personal — never needed in cleartext externally

placeholder_policy.label: PHI / health record IDs
placeholder_policy.examples: MRN, NPI, member/subscriber IDs, diagnosis+record numbers
placeholder_policy.why: HIPAA-class health data — private AI only when concrete

placeholder_policy.label: PCI / banking instruments
placeholder_policy.examples: Card PANs, CVV, IBAN, SWIFT, routing + account numbers

placeholder_policy.label: Deal & finance specifics
placeholder_policy.examples: Name + $42 million, 10% OPEX dip, CRM opportunity IDs (not the name alone)
placeholder_policy.why: Concrete commercial data — hide/scrub before outside AI

placeholder_policy.label: Analysis-scale finance (ratio asks)
placeholder_policy.examples: $45M→$77.85M with session factor; Org_1 / Person_1 / Email_1; format-preserved deal IDs
placeholder_policy.why: Keeps multiples/YoY math valid for the model without sending exact dollars or contacts

placeholder_policy.label: Table / dataset synthetic peers
placeholder_policy.examples: CSV/markdown grids → scaled numbers, fictional names, format-preserved keys; restored on reply
placeholder_policy.why: Full tables stay useful for analysis without leaking real cell values externally

placeholder_policy.label: Open-web / public-market facts
placeholder_policy.examples: Microsoft revenue, Apple CEO, published filings — left clear when not company-private
placeholder_policy.why: Enterprise gate only scrubs non-public / internal details

placeholder_policy.label: Security incident IDs
placeholder_policy.examples: CVE-2024-…, GHSA-…, zero-day labels tied to an asset

placeholder_policy.label: Customer / partner logos with sensitive context
placeholder_policy.examples: Contoso Ltd next to deal value / % / confidential — not 'tell me about Contoso'
placeholder_policy.why: Names alone are Safe; names + deal/confidential depth are competitive intel

placeholder_policy.label: Topic / process words
placeholder_policy.examples: pricing, discount, RFP, revenue, salary, acquisition, confidential
placeholder_policy.why: Marks sensitivity for scoring but must stay so the question still makes sense

placeholder_policy.label: Generic role / process labels
placeholder_policy.examples: manager, forecast, pipeline, NDA, contract (as words)
placeholder_policy.why: Context for the ask — not a concrete secret value
